rationale: dropout 0.0 -> 0.05 inside ResBlock on iter-14 baseline (6 blocks, 32 ch, group norm, res_scale=0.1, wd=1e-4). Tested if light dropout could regularize away the small overfit gap.
advice_for_others: dropout=0.05 hurt headroom by 2.2pp vs iter-14 baseline (0.5870 -> 0.5647). Dropout breaks the residual identity flow in this regime; avoid dropout inside ResBlocks. If regularisation needed, try drop_path or SWA instead.
